title: Workspace and dashboard pair from their own sign-in box; the installed app signs itself in
goal: Typing the short code into an installed app pairs it, and later launches need no sign-in
acceptance: The sign-in box accepts the short code and pairs only in the installed app, which keeps the device credential in persistent storage
Browser tabs keep session behaviour and refuse a pairing code before any request (review of #707)
Browser test of pair → reload → still signed in
privacy: Neutral fixtures only; no personal data.
escalation: A material scope or effort increase goes to the owner

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-23 at agent speed. Not a measurement. Closed 2026-11-24 in the reconciliation: PR #707 merged on green CI; its browser test passes alone and in CI and fails only under local load (B-127); the iPhone check is F-118-T04.
